explication: MAA is an Arknights automation assistant: a user submits tasks through the GUI, CLI, or an integration API; the core interprets task requests, recognizes game screens, and controls the game. Major product branches include combat and drop reporting, base scheduling, recruitment, roguelike automation, copilot battles, and routine collection. The tree and README support these subsystem boundaries, but sampled core excerpts are limited, so edges between task domains and internal services are kept high-level. External reporting destinations are documented capabilities, not inspected implementations.
